welPageTitle.description: Title of the standalone welcome page (welcome.html); the <title> tag carries the English fallback.

welTagline.message: Templates, variables and a queue for manual outreach.

panelPageTitle.description: Title of the side panel document; the <title> tag carries the English fallback.

welHeroTitle.message: Manual outreach, one row at a time

welHeroText.message: Spintax fills contact forms and messages from your list and your template. It never submits anything, never solves captchas, never talks to a server — you press Send.

welOpenDemo.description: Same button as welTryDemo once the demo campaign is already installed.

welDemoInstalled.message: The demo campaign "$NAME$" is installed — five blogs bundled with the extension, nothing real.

welStep1Text.message: CSV, XLSX or paste. Columns become variables — %name%, %site%, %topic%. Rows merge by site or e-mail, so re-imports never duplicate.
welStep1Text.description: %name%, %site% and %topic% are template variable names — keep them as they are.

welStep2Text.message: Spintax: {Hi|Hello} %name%… Every row gets its own wording, reproducible from the row key. Let your AI chat draft it — the prompt is one click away.
welStep2Text.description: {Hi|Hello} is spintax syntax; the words inside may be translated, the braces and the pipe may not.

welStep3Text.message: Open the side panel on a target page, press Fill, check the form, press Send yourself, mark the row. Follow-ups come back on their day.

welQuickText.message: Available on every screen, in the header — they open a drawer and never interrupt what you are doing.

welQuickRowsBlocked.message: Import a list first — rows need columns to land in
welQuickRowsBlocked.description: Tooltip on the disabled "Add rows" chip.

welPanelOpenTarget.message: the row's page (or a new e-mail in your mail app / web mail — see Settings).
welPanelOpenTarget.description: Follows the quoted side-panel button name "Open target" and an em dash: "Open target — the row's page…".

welPanelFill.message: asks for the site once, fills the recognised fields, shows a report per field; rich editors get the text via the clipboard.
welPanelFill.description: Follows the quoted side-panel button name "Fill on site.com" and an em dash.

welPanelSent.message: records the outcome and moves on; "Not sent…" and "More…" hold the other outcomes.
welPanelSent.description: Follows the quoted side-panel button name "Sent — next (S)" and an em dash. "Not sent…" and "More…" quote panel buttons — use the same wording as panelNotSent / panelMore.

welPanelKeysLabel.description: Bold lead-in of the keyboard-shortcuts line; not a button name.

welPanelKeys.message: Enter = primary action, S = sent & next, N = next row (outside text fields). Global shortcuts are yours to assign in the browser's extension shortcuts.
welPanelKeys.description: Follows the bold "Keys" and an em dash. S and N are the physical keys — keep them Latin.

welPanelMappingLabel.description: Bold lead-in quoting the side panel's field-mapping section.

welPanelMapping.message: what went where; point at a field the helper missed, pin a field, forget a wrong recipe.
welPanelMapping.description: Follows the bold "Field mapping" and an em dash.

welPrivacyText.message: Everything stays in this browser profile: lists, templates, journal, files. No account, no telemetry, no network — the only optional request is the 301.sh news feed, off by default. Backup and delete everything from Settings.

welNews.message: Publisher news — a notification when 301.sh publishes a post (checked every 6 hours, nothing about you is sent). Off until you click the bell.
welNews.description: Follows the news bell button on the welcome page.

welPlayground.description: Link to the online spintax playground on 301.st.
